Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers co-upcycling of spent LiNi₀.₆Co₀.₂Mn₀.₂O₂ cathodes and waste polyethylene via hydrocarbothermal reduction, using plastics as both carbon source and reductant.
